Introduction

C-REAL was a five-member girl group under N.A.P Entertainment. They debuted on October 13, 2011 with their first mini-album "Round 1" and its title track "No No No No No". Although their last release wasin 2012, the group did not officially disband until 2016.

The name "C-REAL" comes from combining the first letter of each member's name.
